query:
SELECT address AS "address!", "clientName" AS "client_name!",
                  MIN(COALESCE("firstSeen", "startTime")) AS "first_seen_ms!"
           FROM client_entity
           WHERE (address, "clientName") IN (
                   SELECT * FROM UNNEST($1::text[], $2::text[])
                 )
           GROUP BY address, "clientName"
